title: vlm-cpu-benchmark: A Fair CPU-Only Efficiency and Quantization Benchmark for Small Vision-Language Models
description: A reproducible, CPU-only benchmarking framework for small vision-language models. It separates pre-processing, inference, and post-processing latency and reports peak memory and best-effort RAPL energy under fixed hardware, resolution, and token budgets, across fp32 and custom ONNX INT8 backends, on DocVQA, OCRBench, and a shared binary object-presence task that also compares the VLMs against CPU object detectors in closed- and open-vocabulary regimes. Version 1.0.0 accompanies the paper of the same name.
